scope: Approved: A large rotor/few stages; B small rotor/high reduction; C intermediate rotor/reduction and generative lightening.

bounds.scope: Approved: A large rotor/few stages; B small rotor/high reduction; C intermediate rotor/reduction and generative lightening.
bounds.balance_note: Stage distribution, A input offset and B foot axial placement address CAD-measured COG. Link lengths are unchanged; no ballast or oversized shoe compensation.

objectives: Gear volume proxy +1000*input height +3500*lateral mass-proxy eccentricity; stages distributed to balance axial COG. C minimizes constrained frame-rib volume.
keepouts: Moving legs, whole rotor swept circle, foreign through shafts, bearing/collar/tool seats, chassis ties, printable guards and frames.
